long_description: GenLogs is a freight and truck intelligence company based in Arlington, Virginia, founded in 2023. The company specializes in transportation, automotive, and logistics technology, focusing on supply chain visibility and real-time mobility data. GenLogs utilizes AI, a nationwide network of roadside sensors, cameras, and proprietary datasets to track commercial vehicle patterns across the United States. Its mission is to provide accurate data on motor carriers, enhancing decision-making in logistics operations. The company offers a range of products, including the Truck Intelligence™ Platform, which provides real-time visibility into truck movements and equipment patterns. Other services include a Freight Intelligence Platform for logistics insights, an Asset Tracking Service for monitoring shipments, and a Carrier Search Tool to identify trusted carriers. GenLogs targets various industries, including trucking, insurance, commercial real estate, financial institutions, and government agencies, aiming to improve operational efficiency and combat fraud. The company plans to expand its services across North America.

The platform supports voice and chat interactions, allowing businesses to configure agents using company knowledge, policies, and logic to handle complex conversations and issues at scale.
